title: Music foundations: adaptive discovery

sources.title: Holy Names / Kodály Center Grade 1 curriculum (Laskey 2014)
sources.prerequisite: Prior kindergarten musical experiences; designed for teachers with Kodaly teacher education.
sources.rights: Reference only; no permission to redistribute source materials is asserted.

progress_policy.principle: Progress creates evidence or measurement ability needed for the next question.
progress_policy.invalid_run: Retain observations but do not count as a valid comparison.
progress_policy.source_order: Suggested musical order, not a mandatory score-gated experiment ladder.

runtime_gaps: musical event duration and rest representation
quest manifest loader and quest UI

source_milestones.documented_anchor: Beat through tapping, clapping and walking.
Steady beat contrasted with freer chant.
Rhythm introduced at lesson 4; beat and rhythm explored together.
Ta/ti-ti named at lesson 12; subsequent rhythmic practice.
High/low melody work precedes named pitches.
Re named at lesson 68; staff placement at lesson 70.

quests.title: Find the pulse
quests.question: Can I tell a regular pulse from a freely timed sequence?
quests.brain_adaptation: Define a beat reference and inspect a bounded event timeline.
quests.completion_evidence: A timeline distinguishes a beat reference from event onsets.

quests.title: Keep the pulse while speed changes
quests.question: What changes when timing changes but event order stays fixed?
quests.brain_adaptation: Record both timing schedules before comparing; do not infer tempo learning from fixed-rate text.
quests.completion_evidence: An explicit timing contract makes a rhythm question testable.

quests.title: Separate pulse from pattern
quests.question: Which events share a beat, and can the representation preserve that?
quests.brain_adaptation: Inspect onset-to-beat alignment and distinguish event order from duration.
quests.completion_evidence: A checked rhythm representation supports short motif experiments.

quests.title: Follow pitch direction
quests.question: Can I describe up and down without losing the rhythm?
quests.brain_adaptation: Choose a pitch/duration mapping and check that the event timeline preserves both.
quests.completion_evidence: Verified mapping makes named-pitch experiments interpretable.

quests.title: Explore so-mi
quests.question: What happens on a small two-pitch musical example?
quests.brain_adaptation: Once licensed material and observation support exist, capture pre-outcome predictions on a bounded range.
quests.completion_evidence: A valid baseline allows replay or missing-measurement questions.

quests.title: Explore la
quests.question: Does a finding persist when the material adds another pitch?
quests.brain_adaptation: Keep the earlier question and document changes in vocabulary and material.
quests.completion_evidence: A scoped comparison can expose representation or context dependence.

quests.title: Make silence explicit
quests.question: Does a rest remain distinct from missing input?
quests.brain_adaptation: Validate rest semantics and timing before interpreting outcomes.
quests.completion_evidence: Represented silence enables phrases with rests.

quests.title: Explore do
quests.question: What survives a broader pitch vocabulary?
quests.brain_adaptation: Retain the source and comparison protocol; record negative or inconclusive outcomes.
quests.completion_evidence: A documented scope boundary informs the next experiment.

quests.title: Explore re
quests.question: Does the current finding transfer to this new material?
quests.brain_adaptation: Use reserved material only after independent starting states and frozen evaluation exist.
quests.completion_evidence: A qualified transfer result or a new unresolved question.

discovery_branches.question: What happens on this bounded material?
Does another learning pass change the result?
Does activity settle, grow or disappear?
Does one change affect outcomes, cost or neither?

existing_nonmusical_catalog.role: Optional later text experiments only; not music curriculum material.
existing_nonmusical_catalog.verification: Entry identities verified in catalog; upstream corpus bytes not downloaded again.
